content: A hacker stole a trove of personal information from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). The breach exposes the names, job titles, phone numbers, email addresses, and office locations of more than 41,000 employees, including those in US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP), according to TechCrunch and Wired. The data also linked the agencies to specific surveillance tools. As reported by TechCrunch, a hacker known as “Department of Peace” gained access to the data through Okta, an identity and access management service used by the DHS. Around 21,000 records pertain to CBP employees, and nearly 7,000 belong to staff at ICE. The data also includes records from the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), and Homeland Security Investigations (HSI). The DHS has worked to conceal the identities of CBP and ICE agents, who have carried out anti-immigration raids around the US, while also tracking down online critics. “They have our information, so it’s only fair that we have theirs,” the “Department of Peace” hacker said, according to TechCrunch. This leak comes just weeks after hackers stole data from the FBI on its employees and job applicants. The leaked DHS information was reportedly given to cybersecurity researcher maia arson crimew, who shared it with Distributed Denial of Secrets (DDoSecrets), a nonprofit organization that’s now hosting the leaked “Icepick” dataset. The leak also reportedly includes information about DHS groups that have access to tools that can be used for surveillance, such as the facial recognition app Mobile Fortify and PenLink, which can collect and analyze data from phones and online services. The DHS didn’t immediately respond to The Verge’s request for comment.
chineseTitle: 黑客窃取了 40,000 多份 DHS 员工记录

chineseContent: 一名黑客从国土安全部 (DHS) 窃取了大量个人信息。据 TechCrunch 和 Wired 报道，此次泄露事件暴露了超过 41,000 名员工的姓名、职务、电话号码、电子邮件地址和办公地点，其中包括美国移民和海关执法局 (ICE) 以及海关和边境保护局 (CBP) 的员工。这些数据还将这些机构与特定的监视工具联系起来。据 TechCrunch 报道，一名名为“和平部”的黑客通过 Okta（国土安全部使用的身份和访问管理服务）获得了数据访问权限。大约 21,000 条记录属于 CBP 员工，近 7,000 条记录属于 ICE 员工。这些数据还包括来自网络安全和基础设施安全局 (CISA)、美国公民及移民服务局 (USCIS) 和国土安全调查局 (HSI) 的记录。国土安全部一直在努力隐瞒美国海关边境保护局和移民和海关执法局特工的身份，这些特工在美国各地进行了反移民突击搜查，同时也在追查网上批评者。据 TechCrunch 报道，“和平部”黑客表示：“他们拥有我们的信息，所以我们拥有他们的信息也是公平的。”这次泄密事件发生在黑客从联邦调查局窃取其员工和求职者数据几周后。据报道，泄露的国土安全部信息被提供给网络安全研究员 maia arsoncrimew，后者将这些信息与分布式拒绝秘密 (DDoSecrets) 共享，该组织是一个非营利组织，目前正在托管泄露的“Icepick”数据集。据报道，此次泄露还包括国土安全部组织的信息，这些组织有权使用可用于监视的工具，例如面部识别应用程序 Mobile Fortify 和 PenLink，它们可以收集和分析来自手机和在线服务的数据。国土安全部没有立即回应
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
